gaps: AASW policeCheck: the AASW international-graduate migration guide lists no police or character check; left null rather than asserting none.
AASW outcome validity: not stated in the official guide (only agent blogs claim 3 years), so it is not recorded.

AASW English: MEA page wording for Option 1 is 'overall 7.0 in one sitting' with 7.0 in all four components; guide PDF example shows 7.0 minimum per band. The tool should show 7.0 in each band as the safe reading. IELTS Academic is the only accepted test.

AASW registration: SA swrb.sa.gov.au could not be fetched (DNS failure). The status is taken from AASW pages (position statement 26 May 2026; SA decision 20 June 2026). Some states have role-specific checks (e.g. Working with Children), but the assessor does not state them, so they are not recorded.

CWA registration: no official CWA or regulator page found stating any registration/licensing requirement for these occupations; set null. Sector checks such as NDIS worker screening and Working with Children Checks are not stated by CWA.
CWA policeCheck: not mentioned on CWA occupation pages or document checklist; null.

CWA australianStudyRoute nominalDuration: no official CWA page states course durations; null. The minimum placement hours for CWA-accredited Diplomas are not published on the criteria pages (only the youth-work recognised route states 400 hours).
CWA quotes and criteria were read from communitywork.org.au occupation pages (fetched 2026-10-24). The pages still show a stale portal-maintenance banner for 'Tuesday 16th June'.
aasw.asn.au HTML pages were behind Cloudflare for direct download, so they were read via a fetch tool. The quotes from the MIG guide and the ASWEAS PDF were verified verbatim from the PDF text.
